title: IPv4 Subnetting and VLSM Network Design
summary: Design, calculate, and implement a Variable Length Subnet Masking (VLSM) addressing scheme to efficiently allocate subnets of /26, /27, /28, and /30 without address waste.
learning_objectives: Design a multi-tiered VLSM addressing plan from a single IPv4 /24 classful block.
Calculate network addresses, valid host ranges, broadcast addresses, and subnet masks for /26, /27, /28, and /30 subnets.
Configure Cisco router interfaces and host network settings with non-standard subnet masks.
Verify end-to-end routing reachability across variably subnetted point-to-point and local networks.
Diagnose Cisco IOS configuration errors involving broadcast address assignment and overlapping subnets.
